jobs.title: Director, Consumer Marketing Strategy
jobs.description:
We are a Canadian leader in digital automotive solutions. Our flagship brands — AutoTrader.ca
, AutoSync
, Dealertrack Canada and CMS
— help Canadians buy, sell, and finance vehicles with confidence.

AutoTrader.ca
is Canada’s largest automotive marketplace, with over 25 million monthly visits
. Through AutoSync
, we provide software solutions to 3,500+ dealers
, streamlining their operations, marketing, and sales. Dealertrack Canada
is the country’s top automotive financing portal, processing more than 6.5 million credit applications
each year. Collateral Management (CMS
) is a national tech solution that boosts lien and registration services
, recovery services
, and insolvency management
solutions for Canadian
Lenders

As part of AutoScout24 group
, Europe’s largest online car marketplace, we’re shaping the future of automotive retail in Canada and beyond.

Join us on our journey as we bring together the best of Europe and North America to shape the future of automotive retail.

The role

We’re looking for a commercially minded strategy leader to help shape the next phase of consumer growth for AutoTrader and AutoHebdo, two of Canada's leading consumer brands.

This is an opportunity to own the consumer marketing growth agenda and lead a multi-million CA$ budget.
You'll set marketing priorities and drive growth across Performance Marketing, brand, social media and editorial content.

You'll use data and consumer insights to identify opportunities, make investment decisions and drive execution alongside teams in Canada and across the Autonex group.

This is a hands-on strategy role, working closely with the Canadian executive leadership team
on our consumer marketing strategy and execution. You'll report to the VP, Global Consumer Brand and Canada Consumer Marketing, lead a small Canada-based team and steer shared Performance and Analytics teams through cross-functional influence.

Success will depend as much on your ability to influence, challenge and mobilise others as on your own analytical and commercial judgment.
While there will be campaigns to run - this is an analytical data-driven strategy role with a marketing bent, not an integrated campaigns / media planning role.

We're open to different backgrounds.
You might come from strategy consulting, consumer growth or marketing leadership. What matters is your ability to connect data, consumer insight and commercial strategy - and deliver measurable results.

What you'll do

Deeply understand performance drivers.
Proactively go beyond top-line numbers to identify growth drivers, regional and channel differences, and opportunities for improvement.
Lead investment decisions.
Recommend monthly regional and channel spend adjustments based on business priorities, unit economics and performance data.
Steer Performance Marketing, via influence.
Challenge campaign strategies and drive implementation, working with the centrally managed Performance Marketing team.
Shape brand priorities.
Use consumer insights to guide messaging, content and partnerships across Québec and the rest of Canada.
Re-launch and scale social media marketing.
Build and deliver a structured test-and-learn plan, with clear objectives, measurement and resourcing through hiring and/or agencies.
Lead cross-functionally.
Get buy-in on your plan, establish owners, timelines and success measures, and make decisions without waiting for perfect information.
Lead senior business reviews.
Explain drivers of marketing performance, investment choices and recommended actions to senior leaders.
Develop your direct team.
Set priorities, build capabilities, drive hiring and manage agency performance.

What you'll bring

10+ years in data-driven strategy and transformation
, e.g. strategy consulting, in-house marketing or consumer growth, with people management experience.
Strong hands-on analytical skills
, including advanced Excel skills and basic SQL proficiency. Comfortable going beyond dashboards to investigate data directly.
Proven analytical problem-solving
, including directly deaveraging performance, investigating root causes and translating findings into investment decisions.
Strong understanding of Performance Marketing
, including campaign economics, measurement and investment effectiveness.
Good consumer intuition and brand judgment
, with the ability to evaluate creative work, challenge agencies and improve marketing effectiveness.
AI-forward mindset
, actively using AI tools and building simple agents to automate work, save time and improve effectiveness.
A track record of decisive execution
, influencing teams outside your reporting line and delivering measurable results.
Strong leadership and communication skills
, including developing talent and presenting recommendations to senior marketing and non-marketing leaders.

What's in it for you

We understand that there is life at work and life outside of work. Here are a few benefits we all benefit from that support us to be our creative best.

Benefits from Day 1

Gym discounts
Employee and Family Assistance program
Virtual wellness events
Conferences & training budget
Regular internal training programs

Financial planning

Let us help you invest in your future with 3% matching towards your pension and multiple forms of income protection.

For a career where you can drive our business and shape your future, apply now.

Use of Artificial Intelligence in Hiring: We use artificial intelligence (“AI”) in our hiring process, including to screen, assess, or select applicants for this position.

Vacancy Status: This job posting is for an existing vacancy.

jobs.title: Director, Global Strategy – Strategic PMO
jobs.description:
Your Opportunity at ARC’TERYX:

As the Director of Global Strategic PMO Planning on the Global Strategy team, you are the operational engine behind Arc’teryx’s enterprise-level strategic and key cross functional projects Partnering closely with the VP of Global Strategy, you drive integrated planning, prioritization, governance and decision making to keep the organization focused on the initiatives with the greatest business impact.  

You partner with leaders across the business, establish the governance and decision forums needed to advance complex enterprise initiatives and ensure strategic priorities are embedded within existing planning and governance processes across AC, Product Operations, Technology and Finance.  You align priorities, secure funding and help solve competing demands on organizational capacity.

Your remit spans overall project management for this portfolio of emerging special projects, including managing relationships with external consultants and partners where specialized capacity or expertise is needed.

As a trusted integrator, you bring structure and rigor to enterprise execution, recommend paths forward when functions conflict, and escalate unresolved issues with clear trade-ffs analysis. Your effectiveness is measured by how reliably strategic priorities stay on track and strength of cross functional alignment and execution.

This role is based out of our North Vancouver office and is open to hybrid work (or remote Canada with travels to North Vancouver, BC). Candidates must be eligible to work in Canada.

Meet Your Future Team:

The Global Strategy team is a trusted partner to the executive leadership team in the development, prioritization, and oversight of our company strategies working cross-functionally across the business to ensure attainment of our long-term strategic objectives and goals. We provide strategic insights and frameworks to enable strategy development, cross-functional alignment and executive decision making. We are experts at translating complex, unstructured problems into clear executive level narrative and recommendations. Our team leads the company’s long-range strategic planning process, quarterly business reviews, and the development of an integrated performance management framework to connect our strategy to our annual operating budget and tactical operating plan.

If you were the Director, Global Strategy – Strategic PMO role now, here are some of the core activities you would be doing:

Partnering with business leaders and their teams across functions and regions around each strategic initiative to gain alignment before execution

Facilitating prioritization and presenting key decisions in the appropriate governance forum ensuring timely resolution of trade-offs

Translating strategic priorities and emerging cross-functional demand into a single integrated roadmap that other functions can plan and execute against

Ensuring the organization's limited delivery capacity is focused on the initiatives with the greatest strategic and business impact, reducing fragmentation across competing requests

Partnering with key operational functions like AC, Product and GTM Operations, Technology, and Finance on prioritization, alignment and funding of strategic initiatives, embedding into their existing process and governance

Identifying where strategic or special project require external capacity or expertise, and sourcing, briefing, and managing consultant and external partners against clearly defined deliverables

Providing strategic recommendations to navigate competing priorities across functions, while escalating unresolved issues with clearly articulated trade-offs

Monitoring initiative health against milestones and proactively escalating risk to enable timely leadership decisions before priorities go off track

Building standing forums, reporting rhythm, and documentation that keep functional leaders, the VP Strategy, and Executive Leadership aligned on initiative status

Partnering with Enterprise Planning to align initiative-level work with the broader LTSP/AOP planning calendar, ensuring alignment, visibility and coordinated execution

Orchestrating cross-functional working teams to deliver strategic initiatives, using influence, alignment and credibility to drive outcomes in a matrixed environment

Here are some of the things you could be working on in the future:

Building a repeatable playbook for standing up new enterprise initiatives to enable governance in all future priorities launch 

Shaping how Global Strategy function partners with Product / GTM Operations on development of our multi-year roadmap, and driving accountability and execution as the global-regional formation matures

Are you our next Director, Global Strategy – Strategic PMO?

You have a bachelor’s degree in business, strategy or related field

You have 10+ years of experience in program management, strategy operations, or management consulting, ideally with exposure to a matrixed, multi-region organization

You have a track record of standing up governance for complex, cross-functional initiatives from scratch - you build the structure, not just follow one

You have experience scoping, briefing, and managing external consultants or agency partners as part of a project team, holding them to the same rigor as internal workstreams

You are comfortable operating without formal authority: your influence comes from clarity, credibility, and being the person who makes a hard trade-off legible enough to decide

You can hold multiple initiatives at different stages simultaneously, and know when a risk needs to be escalated versus worked around

You communicate concisely and confidently with senior stakeholders, distilling complex, multi-function status into a clear point of view

You are comfortable with ambiguity in a growing function - you will help define parts of this role as it evolves, not just execute a fixed mandate

A genuine interest in the outdoor industry and the Arc'teryx ethos is an asset, though not a prerequisite for success in this role

Compensation:
The salary range for this role is CAD$149,000 - CAD$195,000 

Total Rewards

Most new team members join between the start and midpoint of the range, where you can contribute right away while continuing to grow your craft, your collaborations, and your impact at Arc’teryx. This range reflects market alignment and the scope of the role. Individual pay is determined by your skills, experience, and level of responsibility.

We’re committed to fair, equitable, and competitive pay, reviewed regularly to ensure internal alignment and market relevance. Transparency is part of how we follow through on our commitments and how we honour the value you bring to our team.

In addition to base pay, Arc’teryx supports people through benefits designed to sustain both work and life:

Health & wellbeing
- Extended health, dental, and vision coverage, including mental health support, fertility benefits, gender-affirming care and a 24/7 Employee Assistance Program (EAP).

Financial wellbeing
- RRSP matching and eligibility for Arc'teryx Annual Incentive Plan and access to Employee Stock Purchase program (ESPP) where applicable.

Time & Flexibilit
y - Paid time off, wellness time, and No Wasted Day program (dedicated paid days to get outside & explore).

Family support
- Parental leave top-up and a nesting period for new parents.

Growth, community & gear
- Professional development opportunities, Arc'teryx Academies (outdoor skill-building events) , Employee Belonging Councils, and access to employee discounts and Pro Deals (exclusive discounted pricing on gear).
  *Eligibility for certain programs may vary by role.

Equal Opportunity

Arc’teryx is committed to actively creating and fostering a culture of inclusivity where voices are heard, people are seen, and values are respected. We care about the uniqueness of our applicants, employees, and guests, and we do so in a safe space fueled by curiosity and acceptance. 

Creating an inclusive workplace is connected to our core value Do Right while also having the added benefit of helping make our business better. We believe inclusion helps us to create a healthier, happier workplace, drive creativity and innovation, and reflect the communities where we operate.  

All applicants, employees, and guests can expect equality of opportunity and fair treatment in alignment with our values.

Leave it Better

We believe that the mountains transform us, that how we adventure matters, and that there’s always a better way. 

Join us in creating positive change in ourselves, our communities, and the world. 

Live it. Get out there - the mountains make us better 
Disruptive evolution . In pursuit of better. Always. 
Commit.  We set bold objectives and see them through. 

Show more

Show less

Not Applicable

Employment type

Full-time

Industries

Apparel & Fashion
